units_checked.description: ids of every region you reached an outcome on

unit.description: the region id from the batch file (unt-...)

outcome.description: test: a passing test that runs the region; unreachable: no public path; intended: should stay uncovered; bug: a test that fails on the current code

text.description: one to three sentences: what the region does and how the test reaches it, or why it cannot be reached, or what is wrong

evidence.description: the path from a public entry point to the region (or the reason none exists), as file:line steps

test_name.description: the test_that description; empty for unreachable and intended

test_file_slug.description: kebab-case words naming the behaviour the test proves (ends in -reference or -contracts); never a TODO number; empty for unreachable and intended

test_code.description: the body of the test_that block, without the test_that line, the closing brace or library() calls; empty for unreachable and intended

reference.description: the independent reference the assertions compare against (closed form, plain-R definition, another package), or the documented error or NA contract for a guard

failure_contains.description: for bug only: text that must appear in the failure message; otherwise an empty string
